name: CRAVE×10
source:
The protagonist lived an ordinary life in a small town nestled in the mountains.

The only things that set him apart were his family's powerful status and the ten female cousins living in the same town.

Upon coming of age, he was required to carry out a "ritual" passed down through generations of his family.

The ritual entailed spending his nights inside the storehouse until it ended.

On the first night of the ritual, a mysterious girl dressed as the Grim Reaper appeared before him and uttered this:

"Hunt down... the ten virgins."

Coinciding with that encounter, a strange urge awakened within him.

It was an impulse utterly unlike his usual self - a desire to ravage and defile women...

[Translated from [url=http://you2game.s10.xrea.com/review/crave-10.htm]Bishoujo Game Review[/url]]
